issues.issue: The 'accrued liabilities' category covers compensated absences due soon. This amount is noncurrent, so 'other liabilities' may fit better. The '(current)'/'(noncurrent)' suffixes in original_label (here and in liabilities[2]) are not printed; on the page both rows are labelled 'Compensated absences payable'.
A nonoperating loss on disposal is recorded as a disbursement under 'other'. This is defensible (already marked review), but 'housing' as the entity's function would avoid a last-resort category.
